description: Read the outgoing webhook of a room the account owns: the URL every Ping in the room is POSTed to, whether it is on, the events it forwards, its delivery health (last_status, failure_count) and its signing_secret, which the receiver uses to check each delivery's signature. outgoing_webhook is null when the room never had one. Treat the secret as a credential.
name: get_outgoing_webhook

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Get Outgoing Webhook
